Samir: Heads up — vendor just pushed the soft-commit for 40 units (H100) out ~9–12 days. They propose a split: 20 air -> SG (fast), 20 sea -> SYD (cheaper) with RMA labels included. Any blockers?
Janelle: Oof. Can we negotiate a late-fee waiver? Our Dedicated pool needs ~16 GPUs next week for a canary rollout.
Ravi: Quick cost note: air vs sea delta ~= +$18k. Expedited RMA handling adds ~$1.2k. If we accept split, unit economics for next month go up — rough: +0.03c/token on high-throughput routes.
Marta: SG customs flagged an HS code mismatch last time — that can add ~48h. Vendor needs to amend invoice HS -> `8471.80` and include serial manifest. Without that, air won't clear.
Emma-broker: Vendor update: AWB for SG batch: `AWB-123-ABC-SG` (20 units). Sea BL for SYD: `BL789-SYD` (20 units). RMA batch IDs: `RMA-5566`, `RMA-5567`. They said late-fee is negotiable if we sign a one-time variance clause.
Kai: Ops alternative: divert 10 GPUs from EU warm-spare pool (can cover immediate demand). Proposal: move 10 EU -> SG (air), accept 20 sea -> SYD, plus 10 remaining air from vendor later. Minimizes air spend.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: `INFRA-1207` for vendor split + provisioning actions. Assignees: Samir, Janelle.
Samir: Action items: Emma push vendor for HS correction + late-fee waiver; Janelle/Kai confirm warm-spare transfer by EOD; Ravi run cost delta and draft exec approval. Also we won't accept any partial RMA returns before serial reconciliation.
Janelle: On it. If we pull warm-spare, steps: tag nodes `nodepool:edge-warm-sg`, cordon & drain -> `./tools/drain.sh --nodes <list>`. I'll coordinate maintenance windows.
Ravi: I'll have a cost delta + break-even for air vs warm-spare in ~90m. Quick idea: if we quantize low-priority workloads (4-bit) temporarily, we can smooth the cost spike.
Marta: Also loop in security/procurement re: export control paperwork — vendor A has alternate export docs that need validation. Could block cross-border moves.
Emma-broker: Vendor uploaded variance PDF to ticket and asked for signature. I also sent AWB screenshots into INFRA-1207. Pinged procurement for late-fee waiver.
Kai: If SG customs still holds it, fallback = spin 8x vCPU cloud fallback nodes for low-priority training runs. Not ideal but keeps SLAs for critical pipelines.
Samir: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Keep updates in INFRA-1207 only. If vendor insists on partial RMA before install, we refuse until serial manifest reconciled.
Janelle: Noted. I'll update ticket with warm-spare node list once drain window confirmed.
Emma-broker: Vendor response ETA: 6h. I'll post update here if they accept waiver/HS correction.
Ravi: Posting numbers into ticket when ready.
Marta: Will reach out to customs broker contact in SG to pre-clear once HS is fixed.
Samir: Great. If anything urgent pops, ping me directly.
